title: Actual completion unit in normalized Roos coordinates
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, an arbitrary scheme morphism h:U→T and a flat-term K-flat integral representative P [def-weil-pbc-proper-integral-ordinary-data]. Let C be its actual pulled strict reduction tower and let c be a chain map from ordinary module pullback of the coefficient transport of P to the Roos mapping cocone of C. Suppose that every first product projection of c is the actual quotient augmentation, and its shifted second coordinate is zero. For any whole-tower quasi-isomorphism r:C→I with I K-injective, and any map iota from the termwise limit of I to its Roos mapping cocone with first coordinates the actual termwise-limit projections and zero second coordinate, the following equality holds. The actual completedPullbackComparison at the coefficient transport of Q(P), followed by Rlim of the actual tower computation counit and Q(r), followed by the universal rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso for I and Q(iota), equals ordinary derived pullback of the coefficient-localization factor for P, followed by its actual ordinary-pullback complex counit, Q(c), and Q(Roos(r)). No ordinary integral model isomorphism, model-matching assumption, or invertibility of iota is assumed.

proof.text: Lift integralDetailedCoefficientComparison to the commutative-ring sheaf category using fullyFaithfulSheafCompose. Apply ringIso_tensor_transport.kflat_iff to the good representative. This gives K-flatness of the actual transported complex; the flat-term clause is not needed for the equality.

Apply completedPullbackComparison_strict_normalization to the transported K-flat complex, the coefficient-localization factor, and r. Its explicit strict augmentation has exactly the actual module quotient components. This computes the completed comparison as the localized constant/limit adjunct preceded by ordinary derived pullback of the coefficient factor and its computation counit.

The constant/limit adjunction counit equation identifies the first projections of its adjunct with augmentation_n followed by r_n. The given iota has these projections and zero shifted coordinate after precomposition. The diagonal mapping-cocone map defining Roos(r) has the same first projections and zero shifted coordinate after c. Degreewise product extensionality and mappingCocone.id_X give equality of the two chain maps. Apply Q and reassociate. All equations include zero complexes and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0941, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok, proof; proetale.tex Tag 099N(5). theorem pbc_integral_actual_unit_roos_normalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] {U T : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ T)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E T).FullSubcategory)
    (c : ((completedModulePullback h (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj ((pbcIntegralTransportComplex T l E).obj P.obj) ⟶
      integralOperationsRoos (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P.obj).asFunctor)
    (hc₁ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
      c.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
        (towerTransitionEndomorphism
          (K := fun n : ℕ ↦ (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P.obj).asFunctor.obj (op n))
          (integralOperationsTowerStep (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P.obj).asFunctor))).f i ≫
        (Pi.π (fun m : ℕ ↦
          (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P.obj).asFunctor.obj (op m)) n).f i =
        (pbcIntegralActualTowerAugmentation l E h P.obj n).f i)
    (hc₂ : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + -1 = j),
      c.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
        (towerTransitionEndomorphism
          (K := fun n : ℕ ↦ (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P.obj).asFunctor.obj (op n))
          (integralOperationsTowerStep (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P.obj).asFunctor))).v
        i j hij = 0)
    (I : CochainComplex (pbcTowers U (pbcAdicCompletion U (pbcIntegralDatum l E))) ℤ)
    (r : pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P.obj ⟶ I) [QuasiIso r] [I.IsKInjective]
    (ι : ((lim : pbcTowers U (pbcAdicCompletion U (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) ⥤
      pbcModules U (pbcAdicCompletion U (pbcIntegralDatum l E))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ integralOperationsRoos I.asFunctor)
    (hι₁ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
      ι.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
        (towerTransitionEndomorphism (K := fun n : ℕ ↦ I.asFunctor.obj (op n))
          (integralOperationsTowerStep I.asFunctor))).f i ≫
        (Pi.π (fun m : ℕ ↦ I.asFunctor.obj (op m)) n).f i =
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (lim.π (op n)) (.up ℤ)).app I).f i)
    (hι₂ : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + -1 = j),
      ι.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
        (towerTransitionEndomorphism (K := fun n : ℕ ↦ I.asFunctor.obj (op n))
          (integralOperationsTowerStep I.asFunctor))).v
        i j hij = 0) :
    completedPullbackComparison h (pbcIntegralDatum l E)
        ((integralDetailedTransport T l E).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
      (completedTowerRlim (pbcIntegralDatum l E) U).map
        (pbcIntegralActualTowerCounit l E h P.obj ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map r) ≫
      (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso
        (lim : pbcTowers U (pbcAdicCompletion U (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) ⥤
          pbcModules U (pbcAdicCompletion U (pbcIntegralDatum l E))) I).hom ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ι =
    (completedOrdinaryPullback h (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).map
        ((pbcIntegralDetailedTransportFactors T l E).hom.app P.obj) ≫
      completedOrdinaryPullbackComplexCounit h (pbcIntegralDatum l E)
        ((pbcIntegralTransportComplex T l E).obj P.obj) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map c ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
        (integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map
          (HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map r))
